Second file is ENVIRONMENT AND LIGHTING reference only; use its clean neutral gray gym walls, dark speckled rubber floor, black gym equipment, soft even realistic lighting. Exercise: standing high-pulley rope triceps pushdown, INITIAL FLEXED POSITION immediately before pushing down. Equipment is one believable black cable station with high pulley above head height, taut continuous steel cable, carabiner, and a single double-ended black braided triceps rope with rubber end stops. Both elbows bent at about 90 degrees, forearms approximately horizontal; rope grips near upper waist. Wrists straight. No overhead extension and no biceps curl. Feet hip-width, knees soft, torso inclined forward only about 10 degrees, neutral back, shoulders relaxed, calm focused face.
Camera lock for this exercise: tripod photograph from a front-side three-quarter view on the athlete's working side; clear view of both elbows, rope and cable path. Medium distance, normal 50mm-lens perspective, camera approximately lower-chest height. Athlete's complete body and shoes inside frame with margins, cable pulley visible near upper edge, no confusing crops. Face sufficiently visible to compare to official reference. Cable station adjacent to him in the same scene; minimal distant black gym equipment.
